title: StyleLock
description: Output of the Style Lock Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7). One StyleLock per project, derived from DirectorPlan.global_style (style.schema.json) plus the Phase 7 cinematic attributes that schema doesn't carry (film stock, grain, bloom, lens effects, a global depth-of-field target). Every shot's prompt is required to reference this lock rather than restate style, so no scene can drift stylistically from the rest of the film.

base_style.description: The DirectorPlan.global_style this lock was derived from.

lighting_language.description: A short prose description of the film's overall lighting philosophy, carried into every shot's prompt (e.g. 'motivated practical lights, warm highlights, deep but detailed shadows').

locked.description: Always true once created - fields are read-only for the lifetime of the project; a deliberate style change requires a new style_lock_id, never an in-place edit.
